comments.author: Steward
comments.body: First off clicking your mouse for hours to raise your in game proficiency is not skill, anybody can do that. In fact game designers made it easy to raise your stats, so new players can compete with veteran players. Second off did it ever occur to you I may already have maxed stats? I've been playing this game over 2 years, and I didn't start with NC, I began buying NC well after I already had high stats, to get the edge over other players with high stats. Overall, the one with the best attack and defense will win. The only exceptions are timing of in battle items used and how tech chains are used. So, would I pay real cash for better weapons and armour to beat your sorry ass with? -Absolutely. I don't care how good you are with your knife, my nuke is still going to win.
